hero_key_art.description: High-octane 3D game key art with diverse stylized low-poly characters in mid-air collision, chaotic urban playground, giant pink CHAOS BOMB, saturated pop colors.

character_banana.description: 3D ragdoll character in a banana suit, dropping coins.

character_rocket.description: 3D mascot character riding a small red rocket.

halftone_texture.description: Comic book halftone pattern background for retro pop art texture overlays.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile-first web app using React and Tailwind CSS (in .js files, not .tsx).
DO NOT USE Inter or Roboto fonts. Use 'Fredoka' for headings/title and 'Outfit' for body.
The hero section should be full-bleed using the hero_key_art image with a subtle halftone texture overlay.
Use Framer Motion to apply bouncy spring entrances to components, and bubble pop effects for the character roster strip.
The 'SOCIAL CHAOS' title should have a chunky 3D effect: glowing neon pink and blue text, heavy text-shadow, and a subtle jiggle animation.
Implement the 'Regenerate Key Art' CTA to mimic a loading state with a 'POW' or comic burst animation while a fake backend call resolves.
Character roster preview strip should sit at the bottom edge, using the character_banana and character_rocket images inside chunky bordered cards.
All buttons must have a solid 4px black border, heavy hard-shadow, and 'press-down' active state effect.
CRITICAL: Apply the `data-testid` attribute on all interactive elements as defined in the testing_attributes section.
